name: food_delivery_app

name: saas_analytics_platform

name: healthcare_digital_transformation
raw: Transform a regional healthcare provider's digital infrastructure. Scope includes: patient portal modernization, HIPAA-compliant telemedicine platform, EHR system integration with 3 existing systems, AI-assisted diagnosis support for radiology, and patient data analytics dashboard. Must comply with healthcare regulations across 5 states. Budget of $2M with 18-month timeline. Current IT team of 12 people, need to scale to 30.
description: High-complexity regulated industry with multiple interconnected systems

name: fintech_microinvesting
raw: Create a micro-investing mobile app that rounds up purchases and invests spare change into diversified ETF portfolios. Must include: bank integration via Plaid, FDIC-insured cash accounts, fractional share trading, automated tax-loss harvesting, and social features (investment clubs). Regulatory compliance required across US and EU markets. $3M Series A, 12 months, team of 15.
description: Regulated fintech with complex integrations and multi-region compliance

name: edtech_adaptive_learning
raw: Develop an adaptive learning platform for K-12 mathematics. Features include personalized learning paths, real-time progress tracking, interactive exercises, and teacher dashboards. Target 10,000 students in first year. Budget $200k, 4 months, small team of 5.
description: Straightforward edtech platform with clear educational scope
